root_causes.pattern: compile-time const misuse with runtime-only floating-point / allocation operations
root_causes.mechanism: The codebase applies const qualification to functions that rely on operations not consistently const-safe across toolchains or that should remain runtime-only. This creates compilation-boundary fragility and overconstrains APIs.
representative_titles: is_finite() llamado en const fn - illegal operation
const fn no puede hacer heap allocations en compile-time
root_causes.fix_strategy: Remove const from runtime-only helpers, or replace with explicit const-safe implementations only where compile-time evaluation is truly required. For floating-point finiteness checks, prefer runtime functions unless a bit-level const-safe check is proven necessary. For allocation-sensitive const code, move construction to runtime or replace with const-friendly fixed-size data structures.

root_causes.pattern: unchecked integer arithmetic and lossy / narrowing conversions
root_causes.mechanism: Integer operations used in sizes, indices, masks, and offsets are not consistently protected against overflow, truncation, or silent wrapping. Conversion boundaries between signed/unsigned and wide/narrow types are not centralized.
representative_titles: Operación aritmética '-' sin protección contra overflow
Operación aritmética '*' sin protección contra overflow
Operación aritmética '+' sin protección contra overflow
Conversión insegura con 'as usize'
Conversión insegura con 'as u32'
root_causes.fix_strategy: Introduce checked/saturating arithmetic at all size and index boundaries, replace ad hoc casts with validated conversions, and use dedicated newtypes for dimensions, indices, and offsets. Promote intermediate computations to wider types where needed, then validate before narrowing.

root_causes.mechanism: Array and slice access is emitted as a large family of issues because the system does not encode fixed-size invariants or safe access contracts strongly enough. The same root cause appears as direct indexing, unchecked array access, and missing assert/get-based guards.
representative_titles: Indexación sin verificación de límites
Acceso a índice sin assert ni validación
Unchecked array access: GRADE_TABLE[i]
Unchecked array access: coeffs[i]
root_causes.fix_strategy: Centralize indexing behind validated access APIs or encode fixed-size invariants in types. For truly fixed-length algebraic kernels, preserve direct indexing only when the dimension is proven statically. For dynamic inputs, use .get(), bounds validation, or domain-specific newtypes that cannot represent invalid indices.

root_causes.pattern: numerical domain-guard missing for singularities and invalid inputs
root_causes.mechanism: The code frequently performs division, square root, logarithms, and related operations without a consistent global contract for valid numerical domains. This produces division-by-zero, division-by-small-value, and invalid-domain issues across crates.
representative_titles: Potential division by zero without validation
Missing NaN/infinity checks in floating-point operations
sqrt() sin garantía de argumento no-negativo
log/ln sin garantía de argumento positivo
Division seguida de multiplicación amplifica errores
root_causes.fix_strategy: Introduce a numerical contract layer that enforces denominator > epsilon, non-negative square-root arguments, and positive log/ln domains at boundaries. Prefer epsilon-guarded reciprocal helpers and centralized precondition checks over scattered local if-statements.

root_causes.mechanism: The code contains many cases of unstable accumulation, exact float comparisons, catastrophic cancellation, and error amplification. These are not domain validation failures; they are precision and stability problems in the numerical method itself.
representative_titles: NaN puede propagarse silenciosamente
Float subtraction - catastrophic cancellation risk
Floating-point equality comparison
Comparación f64 con == es frágil por errores de redondeo
Suma naive acumula error de redondeo - crítico en HPC
root_causes.fix_strategy: Replace naive summations with compensated summation where error matters, avoid exact equality on floats, use tolerances or interval-aware comparisons, and prefer numerically stable formulations for subtractions and chained operations.

root_causes.pattern: hot-path performance inefficiency and algorithm/data-structure mismatch
root_causes.mechanism: The report groups together repeated inefficiencies that are architectural rather than local: unnecessary allocations, repeated len() in loops, resize churn, stable sorts where unstable sorts suffice, clones in hot paths, and complexity that could be specialized.
representative_titles: Nested loops detected - O(n²) or worse complexity
Vec sin capacidad inicial puede causar re-allocations
len() evaluado en cada iteración
resize() inicializa elementos innecesariamente
Posible clone innecesario
root_causes.fix_strategy: Apply preallocation, remove repeated length lookups from loops, replace stable sorts with sort_unstable where ordering stability is unnecessary, eliminate unnecessary clones, and redesign hot-path data structures for dense-access patterns when keys are contiguous.

root_causes.pattern: panic-prone fallible API usage in production paths
root_causes.mechanism: The code uses expect/unwrap and direct panic paths in places where recoverable failure or invariant enforcement would be safer. This turns boundary conditions into crashes and hides the true failure mode.
representative_titles: Uso de .expect() puede causar panic
expect() con mensaje genérico poco útil para debugging
Panic path without safety documentation: unwrap()
Unwrap usage in production code
root_causes.fix_strategy: Convert recoverable fallible paths to Result/Option propagation, reserve debug_assert! for internal invariants, and replace unwrap/expect in production surfaces with explicit error handling and well-typed failure modes.

root_causes.pattern: unsafe usage without explicit safety contracts
root_causes.mechanism: Unsafe blocks and unchecked low-level operations are present without a strong enough safety-contract layer. The system flags documentation gaps, but the real issue is lack of encapsulation and proof-carrying boundaries around unsafe code.
representative_titles: Uso de unsafe sin documentación visible
Unsafe block without SAFETY documentation
Unchecked operation: get_unchecked
root_causes.fix_strategy: Encapsulate unsafe in narrow modules with explicit SAFETY contracts, add proof-style comments tied to invariants, and prefer safe APIs when the performance delta is not measurable. For hot kernels, keep unsafe only where the proof is local and stable.

root_causes.mechanism: One issue remains unclassified in the report and should be manually inspected rather than over-fitted into a broader cluster.
representative_titles: Unknown issue
root_causes.fix_strategy: Manual review only. Inspect the source unit and decide whether it belongs to an existing cluster or requires a new rule.

global_fix_strategy.phase_1: Collapse the 1131 issues into the 8 actionable systemic clusters above, plus one manual-review singleton.
global_fix_strategy.phase_2: Apply global contracts first: integer safety, bounds invariants, numerical domain guards, and stable floating-point policies.
global_fix_strategy.phase_3: Then address hot-path optimization, panic-prone APIs, and unsafe encapsulation.
global_fix_strategy.phase_4: Only after those foundations are fixed, re-run the auditor to measure residual local opportunities.
